name: Fiori Dev Stack
description: Installs SAP Fiori development tools as global npm packages (yo, generator-fiori). Requires Node.js / npm to be installed first.

yo.description: yo (Yeoman) version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.

generator-fiori.description: @sap/generator-fiori version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.
